dayLines: You push through the doors into open air. Haven grounds — tents, a fire pit, worn paths. The world is that way.
You break ground behind the hall — bed 1 of 2, turned and ready. Sow seed to start a crop.
You break ground behind the hall — bed 2 of 2, turned and ready. Sow seed to start a crop.

💧 A man, maybe 40s returns with water: +3 clean.

🍲 A person, maybe 60s, with a wiry build is hunched over their bowl by the fire, eating like it matters.

"Hey." A person, maybe 60s, with a wiry build settles near you, not too close. "Day one. Everyone's pretending they're fine. ...Can we talk? Just talk — like people used to." (Talk to A person, maybe 60s, with a wiry build.)

A woman, maybe 60s and A woman, maybe 40s, with restless hands are arguing about the watch rotation. Again. It's almost comforting.
A person, maybe 50s, with a scarred cheek is hurt — a fall, a thorn, a bad step. (health 77/100)
A person, maybe 30s came back with 365 kcal of something edible. The pantry breathes.
Valeria and Luis lingered over the fire together.
You remember the Machete at your space in the haven and fetch it — it rides in your pack now.
You remember the Work Gloves at your space in the haven and fetch it — it rides in your pack now.

...and then it lands: A woman, maybe 40s, with restless hands speaks 🇺🇸 English. A few shared words. Gestures. Patience.

— Nut trees —
Bark stripped at deer height on a young hickory — teeth, winter, hunger. Somebody winters here. Maybe you will too.
Something big is moving in the woods. The birds went quiet.
You see smoke on the horizon. Stonebridge — 11 people, 3 days in. fishing folk, by the look of it. They know 4 plants — 4 new to you. They've been here the whole time.
You catch fragments by the fire — Rosa telling A person, maybe 60s, with a wiry build about themself. It's picking up decorations as it travels.
A sturdy stick (crafting material).
Journal: Riparian ground. Water means life, and lunch.
📓 Journal: you UNDERSTAND **Green Thumb, Literally**. It resonates with: something unnamed, something unnamed.

Travel 1 tile to Haven.
1 unprocessed haul onto the counter — the clock is ticking.
Someone by the fire nods at the counter. "We pool food here. Keep what you need for the road — the rest feeds everyone, once it's food."
Nobody at the fire knows your haul any better than you do. It'll be your own hands that teach you.
You walk back into Haven. 3 Codex entries. The village is glad to see you.

Valeria has been asking about the strange leaves all week — "but what IS it?" Tonight, an answer. A person, maybe 60s, with a wiry build drew a fan-leafed tree dropping foul-smelling yellow fruit in the dirt for the others. It'll wash away. The knowledge won't.
A person, maybe 60s, with a wiry build: "colonies of umbrella-like leaves, single lemon-sized fruit hidden underneath is coming back thick on the damp slope. Not new — but it's holding."
Chantal is hurt — a fall, a thorn, a bad step. (health 75/100)
🍽️ Ricardo carries the day's surplus to the pantry door, thinks better of it, and turns back to the fire. "It'll only rot in there. We eat."

Fresh-cut stems on the northeast ground — someone else is working turf your crews use. (Stonebridge's foragers, most likely. You walk the ground yourself: it's thinner than your crews alone could strip it.)

sayLines.line: 📖 LEARNED: Engines (Level 2). Diesel: compression ignition, glow plugs, and why bad fuel kills injectors.
📖 LEARNED: Repair & Mending (Level 2). Splint, splice, and bind — a repair doesn't have to be pretty, it has to hold. The right lashing beats the wrong nail.
📖 LEARNED: Steady Hands (Level 1). Fine work under pressure. Dressing game, stitching wounds, tying snares — no shake.
📖 Your old life taught you things. 3 skills from your past — check your Journal.
📖 Your hands remember: knap a Stone knife (stone + vine) — the oldest tool there is. Find the stone.
📖 Your hands remember: weave cloth (3 plant fiber — strip it from cleared brush), and build a Water Filter (cloth + charcoal from fire ashes). Dirty water doesn't have to stay dirty.

You wake up with dirt in your mouth and blood on your hands that isn't yours. The sky is the wrong color — not sunset-wrong, wound-wrong. Maureen Gu. Mechanic. From Columbus, Ohio. That was yesterday. This is now. You have: Tote Bag, Seed packet, Dead Phone, Carpenter's square, Field suture kit. That's everything you own in this world. Haven. Twelve people. The fire is lit. Last night, something w
A person, maybe 30s: "Don't bother picking around the tents. Walk out. The land feeds people who go looking."
📓 Journal: Food won't come to Haven. Walk past the treeline — learn what grows out there, bring it back, and get it named at camp.
You tell the others you're heading out. Someone nods. "Come back before dark."
— DAY 1 DAWN — The world wakes. Animals are active.
Filled 1L (clean — Haven well). 3L carried (3kg). (-10 kcal hauling, 1 tick.) Cistern: 19L left.
A person, maybe 30s shakes their head. "Ask someone who trusts you." (Trust too low.)
A person, maybe 30s walks away from Haven. They don't look back.
A person, maybe 50s, with a scarred cheek heads out for water. "The well won't fill itself."
A man, maybe 50s sets out to find A person, maybe 50s, with a scarred cheek. "Won't be long."
A person, maybe 50s, with a limp heads out for water. "Water first. Everything else waits."
A woman, maybe 30s heads out for water. "Off to the well — back with a full skin."
A woman, maybe 60s heads out for water. "Thirst doesn't negotiate. Going."
A man, maybe 40s heads out for water. "Fetching water. Somebody has to."
A woman, maybe 40s, with a farmer's tan heads out to check the snares. "Wire doesn't lie."
A woman, maybe 40s, with grey-streaked hair heads out for water. "The well won't fill itself."
A woman, maybe 40s, with restless hands heads out for water. "Thirst doesn't negotiate. Going."
Iron cold. Even the ticks are shelved.
— MIDDAY — Honest work hours. Heat builds.
You wait. The light changes. Nothing asks anything of you.
A person, maybe 30s looks at you flatly. "Why should I listen to you?" (Trust too low.)
— DUSK — Animals stir again. Shadows lengthen.
You wait. The light changes. Nothing asks anything of you.
"You haven't earned that yet," A person, maybe 30s says. (Trust too low.)
📋 A person, maybe 50s, with a scarred cheek wants to know what's by the creek. "Just look. Come back and tell me."
💧 A person, maybe 50s, with a limp returns with water: +2 clean.
💧 A woman, maybe 30s returns with water: +4 clean.
💧 A woman, maybe 60s returns with water: +3 clean.
🪤 A woman, maybe 40s, with a farmer's tan is back from the snares: +370 kcal to the pantry.
Recipe: Bark armor (Level 1). You have seen bark armor. Plates of bark laced together, worn like a shell.

🛡️ A woman, maybe 40s, with a farmer's tan catches you eyeing the bark plates — claw-scored, vine-laced. "...Want to actually SEE one?" They talk you through it — wide strips dried flat, laced overlapping like shingles, snug but not tight. Your hands don't know it yet. Your eyes do.
💧 A woman, maybe 40s, with restless hands returns with water: +2 clean.
— NIGHT — Camp. Rest — or risk the dark.
The fire burns lower than it should. Nobody wants to be the one to go for wood in the dark.
You wait. The light changes. Nothing asks anything of you.
You push through the doors into open air. Haven grounds — tents, a fire pit, worn paths. The world is that way.
You break ground behind the hall — bed 1 of 2, turned and ready. Sow seed to start a crop.
You break ground behind the hall — bed 2 of 2, turned and ready. Sow seed to start a crop.

💧 A man, maybe 40s returns with water: +3 clean.
💧 A woman, maybe 40s, with grey-streaked hair returns with water: +3 clean.
🍲 A person, maybe 60s, with a wiry build is hunched over their bowl by the fire, eating like it matters.

"Hey." A person, maybe 60s, with a wiry build settles near you, not too close. "Day one. Everyone's pretending they're fine. ...Can we talk? Just talk — like people used to." (Talk to A person, maybe 60s, with a wiry build.)
⚠ STARVING: health and energy falling. You went to bed on an empty stomach.
Village meal: +1170 kcal, +1L water from the communal pantry. (Half ration — they don't trust you yet.)
A woman, maybe 60s and A woman, maybe 40s, with restless hands are arguing about the watch rotation. Again. It's almost comforting.
A person, maybe 50s, with a scarred cheek is hurt — a fall, a thorn, a bad step. (health 77/100)
A person, maybe 30s came back with 365 kcal of something edible. The pantry breathes.
Valeria and Luis lingered over the fire together.
You remember the Machete at your space in the haven and fetch it — it rides in your pack now.
You remember the Work Gloves at your space in the haven and fetch it — it rides in your pack now.
📓 Journal: the woman in her 30s taught the man in his 40s Silver Tongue.
— DAY 2 DAWN — The world wakes. Animals are active.
Erick Kongolo reads the sky: clear tomorrow, cold.
Hunger gnaws. The pack is thin — work the green, haul it back, get it named at camp. That's the whole game.
A woman, maybe 60s will work the garden once each day while at Haven. Other orders take priority.
You step into the Haven hall.
📋 A woman, maybe 40s, with a farmer's tan — 🎣 Fish. (a natural — good pick) They'll report back by next part.
📋 A woman, maybe 60s — 🎣 Fish. They'll report back by next part.
(Talking costs a little energy — 10 kcal a conversation. Small talk is cheap; going deep costs time, not more food.)
...and then it lands: A woman, maybe 40s, with restless hands speaks 🇺🇸 English. A few shared words. Gestures. Patience.
"Valeria," they say, touching their chest. "I'm Valeria." You'll remember that.
📓 Journal: learned their name (Valeria).
"Rosa," they say, touching their chest. "I'm Rosa." You'll remember that.
📓 Journal: learned their name (Rosa).
"Otto," they say, touching their chest. "I'm Otto." You'll remember that.
📓 Journal: learned their name (Otto).
